name: California SC-100 Small Claims Court Form

plaintiff_name.description: The full legal name of the person or business filing the claim, from the 'Plaintiff (the person suing)' section on page 1 or 2.

defendant_name.description: The full legal name of the person or business being sued, from the 'Defendant (the person you are suing)' section. This may be a company name or individual name.

claim_amount.description: The dollar amount the plaintiff is claiming as damages.

amount.description: The numeric dollar amount claimed, as printed on the form (e.g. '1,850.00'). Do NOT include the dollar sign.

iso_4217_currency_code.description: The ISO 4217 currency code. For US court forms this is always 'USD'.

incident_date.description: The date on which the incident or dispute occurred, from the 'When did this happen?' labeled field. Return in MM/DD/YYYY format.

incident_reason.description: The plaintiff's full narrative explanation of why they are suing, from the 'Explain your claim' or 'Why are you suing the defendant?' free-text section. Extract the complete multi-sentence paragraph exactly as written — do not truncate.
